title: Equestria OS Swap Manager
oom_hint: Mode 1 prevents OOM kills — system slows down instead of killing processes (like Windows).
zram_hint: Compressed swap in RAM — no disk IO, system stays responsive even under heavy load. Prevents watchdog reboot.
win_hint:
One click: zram (50% RAM, zstd) without zswap + swappiness=150 + huge pages madvise + early background reclaim + overcommit=1 + disable systemd-oomd + panic_on_oom=0.
The system slows down under load instead of closing programs.
health_ok: No problems found — swap and memory are set up correctly.
health_legacy: A zram service from an old version is still installed (equestria-zram.service) — it creates a second zram device.
health_extra_zram: Several zram devices are running ({0}) — memory for compressed swap is split between them for nothing.
health_zram_down: zram is configured but not running — the system has no fast swap.
health_no_swap: No swap configured: programs will be closed when memory runs out.
health_zswap: zswap is enabled together with zram — data is compressed twice and wastes memory.
health_swappiness: Swappiness {0} is too low for zram — the kernel drops program code from memory and re-reads it from disk (lags). Recommended: {1}.
health_page_cluster: vm.page-cluster = {0}: 0 is better for zram — lower latency when reading from swap.
health_thp: Huge pages are set to "always": under load programs stall on memory compaction. Recommended: "madvise".
tune_hint: Kernel settings for smooth work under load. Applied immediately and kept after reboot; only changed values are sent.
tune_vfs_cache_pressure_hint: How eagerly the kernel frees the folder and file cache. Below 100 keeps folder structure longer, above frees memory faster. Default: 100.
tune_watermark_boost_factor_hint: Temporarily raises the free-memory threshold when memory is fragmented — causing sudden bursts of reclaim. Recommended for zram: 0. Default: 15000.
tune_watermark_scale_factor_hint: How early the kernel starts freeing memory in the background (in 1/10000 of RAM). Higher means earlier background work and fewer program stalls. Recommended for zram: 125. Default: 10.
tune_dirty_background_mb_hint: How much unsaved data collects in memory before background writing starts. "Auto" is 10% of RAM. With a lot of RAM a smaller value (e.g. 256 MiB) removes freezes when copying large files.
tune_dirty_mb_hint: At what amount of unsaved data writing programs start waiting for the disk. "Auto" is 20% of RAM. Around 1024 MiB is recommended.
tune_thp_hint: always — for every program, at the cost of compaction stalls under load; madvise — only for programs that ask (recommended); never — off.
tune_thp_defrag_hint: When the kernel compacts memory for huge pages. madvise (default) — only for programs that asked; always — may stall any program.
files_hint: Where the app writes its settings. You can open and read them without this window.
files_zram_base: Shared zram-generator config (not changed by this app)
